Subject: Post-demo: hosted API pricing — short asks on monthly tokens + peak TPS

Thanks again for the demo earlier, Elena — great session. Quick recap and two asks so we can put together a tight hosted pricing sketch: 1) confirm expected monthly token range (ballpark is fine: low/likely/high) and 2) confirm front-door peak TPS (tokens/sec) or peak requests/sec and average tokens per request.

What I took away from the call:
- Primary flow: conversational assistant + short document summarization (avg input ~90 tokens, avg gen ~320 tokens -> ~410 tokens/call)
- Expected product traffic ramp: pilot month ~1.2M calls, steady-state 4–12M calls/mo depending on adoption
- Procurement timeline: pilot sign by end of May, production Q3 if pilot meets latency/cost bar

If you can reply to this thread with the three numbers below it’ll let us produce a recommended pricing band and a quick canary plan:
- Monthly tokens: low / likely / high (tokens per month)
- Peak concurrency: requests/sec during spikes (or tokens/sec if you prefer) and duration of typical spike windows
- Target $/1M tokens (your procurement target or internal budget range)

Attached: traffic-sample.csv (small extract we took during the demo for the calculus). I’ll draft a simple cost sketch after your numbers and loop Diego for the formal quote.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted API pricing — short asks on monthly tokens + peak TPS

Karthik — thanks, here are the numbers we can confirm quickly. We pulled these from our analytics team (sanitized):
- Monthly tokens (low/likely/high): 18,000,000 / 37,500,000 / 63,000,000 tokens per month
- Avg tokens per API call: ~420 tokens (we validated across both convo + summarize flows)
- Peak request shape: 3–6 minute bursts driven by notifications: ~1,200 requests/minute during peak -> 20 requests/sec. That maps to ~8,400 tokens/sec during the 3–6 minute window (20 req/s * 420 tokens).
- Long tail sustained peak (daily surge window): ~200 req/minute (3.3 req/s)

Procurement notes: pilot budget cap is $6k/month; production target budget TBD but leadership is looking for $10–$25k/mo depending on SLA and burst support. We’d be happiest around $14/1M tokens if the SLA and fallback plan are solid.

Next steps for us: can you send a simple hosted quote at $14/1M (with details on sustained vs burst pricing and any burst caps), plus a short canary/runbook for pilot traffic shaping? Also include required compliance artifacts for SOC2 in the engagement doc.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if you want to run numbers together.
Elena
Head of Product | StellarSight

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-29T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted API pricing — short asks on monthly tokens + peak TPS

Thanks for the quick numbers, Elena — that helps a lot. A few clarifications and what we’ll deliver by Friday:

Quick clarifications:
- When you say 1,200 req/minute for bursts (3–6 minutes), that implies ~20 req/s and ~8.4k tokens/s. We normally size host-side capacity for token TPS plus request-concurrency; we'll model both.
- Please confirm whether those bursts are synchronous (user-facing) or async/backfill — synchronous spikes will push for lower-latency instance profiles.

Deliverables we’ll send by EOD Friday:
- Hosted pricing sketch: 1) steady-state band (per-1M token price), 2) burst handling options (pre-warmed capacity vs. on-demand burst pricing), 3) estimated monthly $ at low/likely/high volumes you gave (18M/37.5M/63M).
- Canary/runbook: simple 3-step pilot plan (traffic ramp, throttles, fallback to smaller model), and success criteria (latency SLO, error rate, cost cap).
- A short appendix with SOC2 links and a SOW-stub for procurement (we’ll attach SOW-stub-v1.pdf).

One thing to call out for budgeting: if avg tokens/call is 420 then 37.5M tokens is ~89k calls/mo; if your peak is short (3–6 min) we can accommodate with transient burst without large committed capacity — but will show a cost trade-off.

I’ll run the math and include two scenarios in the sketch:
A) No commit (on-demand pricing)
B) Committed monthly slab (discounted $/1M + reserved pre-warm for a 1.5x nominal peak).

If you can confirm whether SOC2 evidence is sufficient or if you need additional compliance items (e.g., specific encryption/HSM proof), note that in a reply and we’ll include it.

Thanks — short sync would be useful Monday morning if you have availability.
Diego
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted API pricing — short asks on monthly tokens + peak TPS

Diego/Karthik — that all sounds good. A couple brief confirmations so your estimate matches our internal budget:
- Bursts are user-facing, yes — synchronous. Duration typically 3–6 minutes, 1–2 times/day during business hours, occasional larger events (weekly digest) that are ~10–15 minutes.
- SOC2 Type II report is our baseline requirement; anything beyond that we’ll flag during procurement.
- For pilot we can stretch to $6k if the pilot deliverables include the canary plan + runbook and a PoC SLA for latency under 500ms p95.

If possible please include a short table in the sketch showing: monthly cost @ $14/1M vs on-demand list price, and the delta if we reserved a small pre-warm pool to cover the 3–6 minute spikes. That will help procurement sign off quickly.

We’re available Monday 09:00–10:00 PT for a short number run.
Elena
Head of Product | StellarSight
